description: Blind execution proxy: target is stripped from x402 facilitator metadata, not hidden from HirePulse or destination. $0.02 single check; company_profile and due_diligence require X-Private-Query-Tier: bundle ($0.04), or the MCP request metadata key "hirepulse/private-tier" outside arguments. The tool arguments contain only tool and target; do not add metadata to arguments. Choose tier before submitting the body. No settlement for empty results.

target.description: Bare public domain for company tools, or a public HTTP(S) URL for clean_markdown; excluded from facilitator metadata, but visible to HirePulse and the destination.

tool.description: Lookup to execute. company_profile and due_diligence require the bundle tier selected in the HTTP header or MCP request metadata.

name: private_blind_lookup
